notes: All six required web searches ran (plus one on the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act), 7 in total; none refused. The official-site search returned only the AI releases already found (NO FAKES Act, Addictive Design Act, McDonald's AI pricing letter) plus housing rent-algorithm bills, which are not about AI risk. The superintelligence, extinction, pause, China and 'AI safety' searches returned no results mentioning Balint. The Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act search (H.R. 10538, led by Casar) showed cosponsor lists that do not include Balint; no source shows she co-sponsored it, but congress.gov was not checked directly. The McDonald's letter quotes are attributed to 'the lawmakers' jointly, so none are included as her statements. The 29 June 2026 Protecting Young Minds Online Act release has no Balint quote mentioning AI. The two D quotes were re-confirmed in this run by opening the press releases, but through a page-fetch tool that summarizes pages, so a reviewer should confirm exact wording on the linked pages.
